description: Search Sandooq's public pages and blog articles by keyword, returning ranked titles, URLs and excerpts. Follow a result with get_page to read it in full.

limit.description: How many results to return. Default 5, maximum 20. `matchCount` reports the total number of matching pages regardless.

locale.description: Response language: 'en' (default) or 'ar'. Arabic returns the Arabic copy the site publishes, not a translation of the English.

query.description: Words to search for. Matched case-insensitively against page titles and body text in the chosen language; there is no stemming, so the words a reader would use work best.

name: search_docs
title: Search Docs
